test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The circumference of the base of a solid right circular cylinder is 136.4 cm and its height is 50 cm. What is the volume (in cm³) of the cylinder? (Take π = (22)/(7)).
solution:
**Given:**

Circumference of the base of a solid right circular cylinder = 136.4 cm.

Height of the cylinder = 50 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

Circumference = 2πr

⇒ 136.4 = 2 × (22)/(7) &ti
